CUSTOM (hand-written) vhost.conf / vhost_ssl.conf overrides
These are NOT regenerated by Plesk and WILL be lost in a template-driven rebuild.
NOTE: 'INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=no' means the file exists but Apache never reads it.

==============================================================================
HOST: git.ltvb.nl
  vhost.conf     non-empty=yes  INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=yes
  vhost_ssl.conf non-empty=yes  INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=yes

----- /var/www/vhosts/system/git.ltvb.nl/conf/vhost.conf -----
Protocols http/1.1
ProxyPass /cable ws://127.0.0.1:28082/cable
ProxyPassReverse /cable ws://127.0.0.1:28082/cable

----- /var/www/vhosts/system/git.ltvb.nl/conf/vhost_ssl.conf -----
Protocols http/1.1
ProxyPass /cable ws://127.0.0.1:28082/cable
ProxyPassReverse /cable ws://127.0.0.1:28082/cable


==============================================================================
HOST: github.lucasvanbriemen.nl
  vhost.conf     non-empty=no  INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=no
  vhost_ssl.conf non-empty=yes  INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=no

----- /var/www/vhosts/system/github.lucasvanbriemen.nl/conf/vhost_ssl.conf -----
  <IfModule mod_ssl.c>
      # WebSocket Proxy Configuration for Reverb
      ProxyPreserveHost On
      ProxyRequests Off

      # WebSocket connections
      ProxyPass /app wss://localhost:8080/app
      ProxyPassReverse /app wss://localhost:8080/app

      # Enable WebSocket support
      <IfModule mod_proxy_wstunnel.c>
          RewriteEngine On
          RewriteCond %{HTTP:Upgrade} websocket [NC]
          RewriteCond %{HTTP:Connection} upgrade [NC]
          RewriteRule ^/(.*)$ "wss://localhost:8080/$1" [P,L]
      </IfModule>
  </IfModule>
  EOF

HOST: login.ltvb.nl
  vhost.conf     non-empty=yes  INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=yes
  vhost_ssl.conf non-empty=yes  INCLUDED BY httpd.conf=yes

----- /var/www/vhosts/system/login.ltvb.nl/conf/vhost.conf -----
SetEnv RAILS_MASTER_KEY deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef

# IP whitelist (added 2026-06-05)
<Location "/">
    Require ip 62.194.231.108 2001:1c00:9501:6700::/64 93.184.105.110 87.106.231.214 127.0.0.1 ::1
</Location>
# Keep Lets Encrypt renewals working
<Location "/.well-known/acme-challenge">
    Require all granted
</Location>

----- /var/www/vhosts/system/login.ltvb.nl/conf/vhost_ssl.conf -----
SetEnv RAILS_MASTER_KEY deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef

# IP whitelist (added 2026-06-05)
<Location "/">
    Require ip 62.194.231.108 2001:1c00:9501:6700::/64 93.184.105.110 87.106.231.214 127.0.0.1 ::1
</Location>
# Keep Lets Encrypt renewals working
<Location "/.well-known/acme-challenge">
    Require all granted
</Location>


----- /var/www/vhosts/system/login.ltvb.nl/conf/vhost.conf.bak-whitelist (stray backup) -----
SetEnv RAILS_MASTER_KEY deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef

----- /var/www/vhosts/system/login.ltvb.nl/conf/vhost_ssl.conf.bak-whitelist (stray backup) -----
SetEnv RAILS_MASTER_KEY deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef
